title: fix(proxy): close the sibling-import bypass and serialize the approval record
why: The trampoline's doc says the source arrives on stdin because running the file would open it a second time, after the approval check, and a caller could swap it in between. The obvious fix (run the file with -I or -P) breaks that rule. The same doc also defends the sibling import as a feature, so it argues both ways.
adaptation: The fix's three runner tests, with write_script inlined, since the tests module's helpers are private. The sibling test accepts any refusal in which the sibling never ran, not only a ModuleNotFoundError. The approval-record race is in the bug report and the reference diff but not in the withheld test.
